Ready to become an AI Engineer and remain relevant in the world of tech?

Don't be left behind. The industry has changed you have to change too. This is for you if you're into backend, frontend, marketing etc

We will learn about Plans, Loops, Sub-Agents, Tool-Calling, Skills, Self-Verification, Planning + Executions, Critic, Verifier, Coordinating Agents.

If you are still using Prompt → Response, you are behind the times already. You should be doing the Agent Loop (Goal → Planner → Workers → Tests → Self Verification).

In the new HNG, everyone is a beginner. It does not matter if you start as a designer, PM, Coder or Marketer - you have skills needed to build complex and real products with AI. It's time to unlearn and relearn.

Upgrade to Premium Plus

Want More From Your Internship?

The HNG Internship starts at just ₦9,000. Upgrade to Premium Plus if you'd like additional support throughout your journey.

Premium Plus includes:

- • Foundation classes & Mentor feedback on tasks
- • Premium Certificate
- • Career guidance - Portfolio & CV reviews, Mock interviews etc
- • Exclusive webinars
- • Extended progression before deactivation

Complete Your Registration

Become an AI Product Engineer in few weeks

You will learn how to code with AI, build and ship a real product. AI is changing every industry, and companies need people who know how to build with it. HNG Internship 15 helps you go from learning AI tools to using them confidently to create products, solve real problems, collaborate with teams, and build a portfolio that gets you noticed. Start with the same foundation as everyone else, then grow into the area where you can create the most impact.
